name: Akinakes of Acrisius
lore: The short, leaf-shaped blade of Acrisius, king of Argos, who locked his daughter Danae in a bronze tower because an oracle said her son would kill him. Perseus killed him anyway, by accident, with a discus throw at funeral games. The blade survived the prophecy. The blades always do.
curve_note: base_damage = curve.weapon_base_damage(48) x 1.4 unique-mult, finesse precision (8 x 1.4 = 11.2 -> 11). Class: finesse 5-rung [0.20, 0.55, 1.00, 1.80, 3.00]. F40-49 Medusa-era band fill.
